It does not specify the target direct links (0->1, 0->3, 2->4), the unobserved-intermediate relationship {2,5}, or the maximum number of explanatory variables as the required parameter. Its latent-signature evaluation only broadly matches the requested pair detection; it does not name {3,4}. References to an external design file cannot establish missing details.
